texts.compensation_resident.resident: I ACKNOWLEDGE the damage claim above and its amount. I understand that Housing Solutions DOES NOT APPLY ANY DEDUCTION: the report is forwarded to my employer / client, and any deduction is decided by their payroll under their own rules. My signature confirms that I was informed of the claim; it is NOT consent to a deduction.
texts.damage_report.resident: I have read the damage report above and ACKNOWLEDGE its contents and the assessed amount.
texts.document.resident: I have read and understood the document above.
texts.inspection.resident: I have been informed of the result of the inspection. Result: {{eredmeny}} (hygiene score: {{pontszam}}). I understand that a hygiene score of {{kuszob}} or below counts as a FAILED result, and that after {{alkalom}} consecutive failed inspections a penalty under the house rules — currently {{osszeg}} HUF per person — may be imposed. I understand that my signature confirms that I was INFORMED of the result and of this consequence.
texts.staff: I presented the report to the person present and reviewed its contents together with them.
texts.witness: As a witness I confirm that the report was presented to the person above, and that they signed it — or refused to sign it — in my presence.
